title: Out-of-the-Box Global Optimization for Packing Problems: New Models and Improved Solutions
summary: Recent LLM-driven discoveries have renewed interest in geometric packing problems. In this paper, we study several classes of such packing problems through the lens of modern global nonlinear optimization. Starting from comparatively direct nonlinear formulations, we consider packing circles in squares and fixed-perimeter rectangles, packing circles into minimum-area ellipses, packing regular polygons into regular polygons, and packing Platonic solids into Platonic solids.
